title: LLM Validation Makes Minimal-Pair Benchmarks Easier for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.13788v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Minimal-pair benchmarks are only as good as their labels, and LLMs are an obvious substitute for costly human validation. We test it on BLiMP (English) and QFrBLiMP (Quebec French), the two public minimal-pair datasets releasing every forced-choice human judgment. Three LLMs validate by forced choice, by rating, and as a panel, scored against human panels of one, three and five judges in two pre-registered phases. On BLiMP, forced-choice validators agree with held-out human majorities more often than five-judge panels, yet catch far fewer pairs whose label humans reject than one judge does. By point estimate, no validator is worth more than one judge. The errors are not random. On both datasets, across 10 open LMs, human-supported pairs that the pre-registered LLM filter flags are 18.9 points harder than those it accepts, in all 70 LM-validator combinations, and harder than pairs a single human judge flags. translated_title: LLM验证使最小对子基准对语言模型而言变得更简单
translated_abstract: 最小对子基准的质量完全取决于其标签，而大语言模型（LLM）是昂贵的人工验证的显而易见替代方案。我们在BLiMP（英语）和QFrBLiMP（魁北克法语）上测试了这一方法，这两个公开的最小对子数据集发布了每一份强制选择的人类判断。三个LLM分别通过强制选择、打分和评审小组的方式进行验证，并在两个预注册阶段与由一名、三名和五名评委组成的人工评审小组进行对比评分。在BLiMP上，强制选择验证器与留出的人工多数意见的一致率高于五人评审小组，但它们能发现人类拒绝其标签的句子对的数量远少于单个评委。从点估计来看，没有任何验证器的价值超过一名人类评委。这些错误并非随机的。在两个数据集上，跨越10个开源语言模型，被预注册的LLM过滤器标记的有人类支持的句子对，比它接受的句子对难18.9个百分点，且在所有70个语言模型-验证器组合中均是如此，也比单个人类评委标记的句子对更难。因此，过滤操作移除的是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 用LLM验证最小对子基准的标签并非随机出错，而是系统性地移除对语言模型而言更难的句子对，使基准变简单，且其验证效果并不优于一名人类评委。
en_tdlr: LLM-based validation of minimal-pair benchmarks errs systematically rather than randomly—filtering out the hardest items and making benchmarks easier for language models—while being no better than a single human judge.
